name: LinkDevi — RSS articles to saved campaign share kits

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Create a LinkDevi account, then a scoped key with links:read and links:write. Hosted plan limits apply.
2. In Create saved campaign, select a Header Auth credential: header name Authorization, value Bearer YOUR_SCOPED_KEY. Keep the key only in n8n Credentials.
3. Keep retries disabled. Redirects are disabled so credentials stay on the configured origin.
4. Preview your data before running. Each selected channel uses one stored-link slot. A timeout may have committed: preserve requestId and the exact campaign payload on retry.
5. These workflows do not call an LLM, send email, post to social media or enable a schedule. Activate only after reviewing your own setup.
Guide: https://linkdevi.com/features/ai

## RSS setup
Set your actual feed URL and replace feedNamespace in Prepare article identities with a stable unique value for that feed. Process at most five entries per manual run. IDs are deterministically derived using the built-in Crypto node, so unchanged articles replay safely. Keep the namespace, title, destination and campaign settings stable across retries. An edited title/destination with the same identity conflicts: review it before intentionally starting a new intent. Repeat runs still use API requests even when no extra links are created. No social post is sent.
